title: Silver gear
description: Minecraft adds the ability to have equipment, why not a silver stuff ?
body:
![silver gear by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2cb935c10fa8545ccb8fefe8371e988c45ac6b83.png)

Minecraft adds the ability to have equipment made of copper, iron, gold, diamond, and netherite (I haven't forgotten the useless chainmail). Why isn't silver, such a common material in our world, included?

This mod fixes that! Silver equipment has more or less the same stats as iron equipment, except for 0.5 extra damage and almost twice the durability!

**Spoiler alert:** 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

You'll find the ore in layers 32 to 0 and the deepslate ore in layers 0 to -32 !

</details>
